# Load packages & set variables

```{r}
#| label: load packages
#| message: false # removes tidyverse loader & here location for privacy
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(tidymodels)

source(here("functions", "set_env-variables.R"))
source(file.path(PATH_FUNCTIONS, "load_functions.R"))
```

# Load Dataset

```{r}
#| label: load dataframe

reconstructed_df <- load_reconstructed_df()
```

# Split and save

```{r}
#| label: train test split
set.seed(94)

split_data <- group_initial_split(data = reconstructed_df, prop = 0.8, group = "pid")
train_df <- training(split_data)
test_df <- testing(split_data)
```

```{r}
#| label: save to folder

save_split_df(train_df, "train")
save_split_df(test_df, "test")
```

# Diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: load again

train_df <- load_split_df("train")
test_df <- load_split_df("test")
```

```{r}
#| label: print sizes

n_train <- nrow(train_df)
n_test <- nrow(test_df)
n_train_filtered <- nrow(train_df %>% filter_relevant())
n_test_filtered <- nrow(test_df %>% filter_relevant())
print("Unfiltered")
print(paste0("train: ", n_train, ", test: ", n_test, " (", n_train / (n_train + n_test) * 100, "%)"))
print("Filtered")
print(paste0("train: ", n_train_filtered, ", test: ", n_test_filtered, " (", n_train_filtered / (n_train_filtered + n_test_filtered) * 100, "%)"))
```

```{r}
#| label: give train vs test depression
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

# combine dfs with indicator
train_df %>%
  mutate(group = "Training") %>%
  bind_rows(test_df %>%
    mutate(group = "Test")) %>%
  mutate(group = fct_infreq(group)) %>%
  # only keep relevant cases
  drop_na(depression_phq4_binary_in_1y) %>%
  # count & prepare
  count(group,
    depression_phq4_binary_in_1y,
    wt = weight
  ) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(
    prevalence = n / sum(n),
    prevalence = scales::percent(prevalence, accuracy = 0.01)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(depression_phq4_binary_in_1y) %>%
  select("Set" = group, "% above cutoff" = prevalence) %>%
  export_return(
    "03_depression_prevalence_split",
    caption = "Reports the percentage of individuals displaying depressive symptoms above the PHQ-2 threshold in the training and testing sets.",
    label = "depression_prevalence_split",
    tabular.environment = "tabular",
    align = c("l", "r")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: visualize train vs test prevalence of depression
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 4

# combine dfs with indicator
train_df %>%
  mutate(group = "Training Set") %>%
  bind_rows(test_df %>%
    mutate(group = "Test Set")) %>%
  mutate(group = fct_infreq(group)) %>%
  # only keep relevant cases
  drop_na(depression_phq4_binary_in_1y) %>%
  mutate(depression_phq4_binary_in_1y = factor(
    depression_phq4_binary_in_1y,
    levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
    labels = c("Below", "Above")
  )) %>%
  # count & prepare
  count(group,
    depression_phq4_binary_in_1y,
    wt = weight
  ) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(n = n / sum(n)) %>%
  # plot
  ggplot(aes(x = depression_phq4_binary_in_1y, y = n, fill = depression_phq4_binary_in_1y)) +
  facet_wrap(~group) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_label(
    aes(label = scales::percent(n, accuracy = 0.1)),
    vjust = 1.2,
    size = 4,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "horizontal") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Above" = palette_qualitative[1], "Below" = palette_qualitative[2])
  ) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "PHQ-2 Cutoff Status",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "",
    title = "Prevalence of elevated PHQ-2 Scores per Split",
    subtitle = "Cutoff for clinically relevant PHQ-2 Scores: ≥3"
  ) -
  partial(export_return,
    filename = "03_symptom_prevalence_per_split",
    width = 5,
    height = 4
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: visualize train vs test distribution of depression
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

# combine dfs with indicator
train_df %>%
  mutate(group = "Training Set") %>%
  bind_rows(test_df %>%
    mutate(group = "Test Set")) %>%
  mutate(group = fct_infreq(group)) %>%
  # only keep relevant cases
  drop_na(depression_phq4_score_in_1y, depression_phq4_binary_in_1y) %>%
  # count & prepare
  count(group,
    depression_phq4_score_in_1y,
    depression_phq4_binary_in_1y,
    wt = weight
  ) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(n = n / sum(n)) %>%
  # plot
  ggplot(aes(x = depression_phq4_score_in_1y, y = n, fill = depression_phq4_binary_in_1y)) +
  facet_wrap(~group) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_label(
    aes(label = scales::percent(n, accuracy = 0.1)),
    vjust = 1.1,
    size = 3.5,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 6, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.075))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "horizontal") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = palette_qualitative[1], "FALSE" = palette_qualitative[2]),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Below Cutoff", "TRUE" = "Above Cutoff")
  ) +
  # guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Symptom Score",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "",
    title = "Distribution of PHQ-2 Symptom Scores per Split",
    caption = ""
  ) -
  partial(export_return,
    filename = "03_symptom_score_per_split",
    width = 10,
    height = 10
  )
```
